Brand.escape: Right after Brand uses Brand W Pillar of Flame is your chance to go in with an ally. If you aren't ablaze, Brand Q Sear can't stun you, making it easier to close the distance.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing, and don't stand beside an ally who is ablaze. Stay by your most fed ally and use Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth in response to Brand's attacks.
Brand.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand deals mostly magic damage, and Brand P Blaze deals damage based on max health, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.combo: If an ally is caught, interrupt Brand's follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy, time Lulu E Help, Pix! with the incoming damage, then slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to die, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Brand.
Brand.fight: Once Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, you have a chance to close the distance. Follow an ally's engage instead of diving in first, and interrupt Brand with Lulu W Whimsy as he tries to use a follow-up ability. If an ally has closed the distance, use Lulu R Wild Growth to knock Brand up and keep him there.
Brand.laning: If you last-hit beside a burning minion, Brand E Conflagration can spread, so step to the side of the wave. Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but save Lulu E Help, Pix! to block Brand's damage. If you get low on mana, don't force a fight; set up a recall.
Brand.phase: Early on, Lulu has strong poke and slows but is fragile, so dodge Brand's first ability and turn back on him. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry.
Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear first to prevent Brand P Blaze from stacking and exploding. If you're ablaze, move out of the line of Brand Q Sear's projectile or stand behind a minion to avoid the stun. If you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from your allies to prevent it from bouncing.

Ashe.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance provides strong poke, but Lulu is fragile, so don't trade while taking Ashe's basic attacks and Ashe W Volley. In the late game, focus on protecting your allied carry who has scaled.
Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on. Ashe deals mostly physical damage and Lulu has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.combo: If an ally is about to die, use Lulu R Wild Growth to increase their health. If Ashe is near them, knock her up to interrupt her attack.
Ashe.fight: Look to trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has worn off.
Ashe.laning: Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, then poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance right after it's down. Keep your distance so Ashe's basic attack slow doesn't catch you, and save Lulu E Help, Pix! to block incoming damage rather than use it for poke. If you're low on mana, don't force a fight; set up a recall.
Ashe.teamfight: Stay by your most fed ally and watch who Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and her follow-up attacks are targeting.
Ashe.watch: Move sideways to dodge Ashe W Volley, which attacks in a cone and slows. Ashe P Frost Shot's slow is refreshed with every basic attack, so don't stay within her basic attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don't start a small fight from out of vision; if the arrow comes your way, change direction as you move.
Ashe.escape: Look for an opening after Ashe W Volley and Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow are down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has worn off. Rather than walking up while slowed by Ashe’s basic attacks, respond when your team closes the gap all at once.

Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no ability to create distance, so if an ally goes around his turret setup and reaches him, slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If needed, cast Lulu R Wild Growth on the engaging ally.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: If an ally is caught, respond with Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, then Lulu Q Glitterlance, and save them with Lulu R Wild Growth when lethal damage comes in. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is available, don't group at one spot in a narrow passage or in front of an objective.
Heimerdinger.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Heimerdinger's main damage is all magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Heimerdinger.combo: When Heimerdinger gets close to an ally and tries to use a follow-up ability, interrupt him with Lulu W Whimsy. Time Lulu E Help, Pix! with the incoming damage, then slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to fall to heavy damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Heimerdinger.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don't trade head-on in front of his turrets. Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance while keeping your distance. Don't dive in deep on your own.
Heimerdinger.laning: Early on, use Lulu Q Glitterlance's poke and slow, but don't chase into Heimerdinger's turret setup. If you're low on mana, stop forcing trades and set up a recall.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Lulu has strong poke but is fragile, so trading in front of Heimerdinger's turrets puts you at a disadvantage. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry and fight alongside them.
Heimerdinger.watch: When you see the landing marker, move sideways to avoid the center. If you're hit, use Lulu E Help, Pix! to block the follow-up damage and get out of turret range.

Karma.fight: Poke safely with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t force an engage by closing the distance first. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has ended, that’s your chance to go in with your ally. In a close-range fight, you can use Lulu R Wild Growth on an ally to knock up Karma nearby.
Karma.escape: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has ended, close the distance with your ally. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, don’t engage; slow Karma with Lulu Q Glitterlance while backing away. Casting Lulu W Whimsy on your ally to increase their movement speed can help them break the tether and escape.
Karma.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, and Lulu has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of persistent crowd control that can hold your allies in place, get Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Karma.combo: If Karma engages on an ally, cast Lulu W Whimsy on Karma first to interrupt her follow-up abilities, then protect your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! and slow Karma with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Watch Karma’s cast animation and time Lulu E Help, Pix! to shield your ally as the damage comes in. If your ally is about to die, use Lulu R Wild Growth to immediately increase their maximum health and knock up nearby enemies.
Karma.laning: Position behind minions or out of range so you don’t take Karma Q Inner Flame for free. When poking with Lulu’s basic attacks, minions can intercept Pix’s bolt, so look for a moment when Karma steps beside the minion wave. Don’t spend Lulu E Help, Pix! on poke; use it as a shield when Karma’s damage is coming, and set up a recall when you’re out of mana.
Karma.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance has strong poke and slow, but Lulu can easily fall apart if she takes damage, so dodge Karma’s poke and counterattack. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry, and grow stronger alongside them.
Karma.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch Karma’s engage and who Karma W Focused Resolve targets. If an ally is caught, counter with Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, then Lulu Q Glitterlance, and use Lulu R Wild Growth in a dangerous moment. If Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra shields nearby allies, engage after the shields end.
Karma.watch: Repeatedly getting hit by Karma Q Inner Flame reduces Karma R Mantra’s cooldown, so dodge by moving behind minions or outside its range. If you’re hit by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, immediately walk out of the remaining circle. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance and break the tether before it roots you.

Lux.laning: Spread out sideways from your ally so Lux Q Light Binding can’t catch both of you. Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance while conserving mana, and use Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield after watching Lux’s cast animation. If you’re hit by one of Lux’s abilities, don’t stay within basic attack range while marked.
Lux.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Lux Q Light Binding targets. Protect them with Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth. Don’t approach grouped together with your allies, or Lux E Lucent Singularity may trap all of you at once. Respond when Lux Q Light Binding misses or an ally is caught instead of engaging first.
Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two enemies it hits, so it’s dangerous even if you stand in a straight line behind an ally. Lux R Final Spark shows a red targeting line first, so if you’re low on health and retreating, dodge sideways when you see the line. If you’re hit by one of Lux’s abilities, leave basic attack range so she can’t trigger Lux P Illumination with an attack.
Lux.escape: The window to close the distance is after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance, so when your ally gets close, slow her with Lulu Q Glitterlance and, if needed, use Lulu R Wild Growth to knock her up as she tries to escape.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then close the distance with your ally. Until then, poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t force an engage. If Lux catches an ally, interrupt her follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy and block the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!.
Lux.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lux deals mostly magic damage, and Lulu has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: If an ally is rooted by Lux Q Light Binding, interrupt Lux’s follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy, block the next damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow Lux with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to die to burst damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.
Lux.phase: Lulu Q Glitterlance is strong for early poke, but Lulu herself is fragile, so play safely while dodging Lux Q Light Binding. In the mid and late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry; the more they grow, the stronger Lulu becomes alongside them.

Milio.laning: Early on, use the poke and slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance to contest control of the wave. Trade against Milio’s healing, but save Lulu E Help, Pix! for a moment when you need a shield. When you’re low on mana, don’t force a play; set up a recall.
Milio.combo: If an ally is caught, interrupt the enemy’s follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy. Shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the damage comes in, then slow the enemy with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When your ally gets onto Milio, use Lulu R Wild Growth on them to knock up Milio nearby. Milio R Breath of Life cannot remove this knockup.
Milio.escape: The window to engage on Milio is after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down. He has no other ability to create distance on his own, so if your ally gets close, help them engage with Lulu R Wild Growth to knock Milio up.
Milio.fight: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t force an engage first. If an enemy engages, interrupt their follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy, block the damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, and counterattack. After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, look for a chance for your ally to close the distance on Milio.
Milio.build: Early on, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Milio P Fired Up! and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If fights last long enough for healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life to become a problem, get an anti-heal option.
Milio.phase: Early on, Lulu can poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but she is fragile, so be careful when trading hits. Milio’s team also gets stronger over time, so claim early control of the game and focus on protecting your fed allies in the late game.
Milio.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who the enemy engage targets. When they engage, use Lulu W Whimsy on the enemy, then protect your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! and Lulu R Wild Growth. If your ally can engage on Milio himself, help with the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only way to disengage, knocking back the first target it hits, so delay engaging when you’re in its line. If Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and has increased the enemy marksman’s range, delay the fight for its duration. Milio R Breath of Life removes immobilizing effects but does not remove knockups.

Nautilus.laning: Keep minions between you and Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and stay within range to retaliate if Nautilus engages. Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion's bolts can hit minions instead, so poke with basic attacks when the enemy steps out beside the minion wave. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield instead of wasting it on poke, and look for a good time to recall when your mana runs out.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Nautilus Q Dredge Line targets. Respond with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix! When Nautilus gets close and tries to deal heavy damage, use Lulu R Wild Growth to save your ally and knock up nearby enemies. Don't stand in line with an ally along the path of Nautilus R Depth Charge.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so keep minions between you and him to block it. After he gets close, Nautilus P Staggering Blow can root you with his first basic attack, so stay out of its range. If Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don't stand in line with an ally along its path.
Nautilus.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads. Nautilus's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that can lock down your allies, get Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Nautilus.combo: If an ally is caught by Nautilus Q Dredge Line, cast Lulu W Whimsy on the enemy as Nautilus's dash ends and he tries to use a follow-up ability. Then block the damage with Lulu E Help, Pix! and slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When an ally is about to take heavy damage, use Lulu R Wild Growth to increase their maximum health and knock up nearby Nautilus, stopping his engage.
Nautilus.escape: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to close the gap and trade or retreat. After Nautilus Q Dredge Line has been used, he has no mobility ability to follow you, so create distance. Get away before Nautilus P Staggering Blow's first basic attack reaches you.
Nautilus.fight: Trade right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Use Lulu Q Glitterlance to slow and poke him, but don't force an engage yourself first. Even if Nautilus is slowed by Lulu Q Glitterlance, stay out of range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow's basic attack.
Nautilus.phase: Early on, Lulu can poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but she's fragile and vulnerable if Nautilus engages on her. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed carry.

Pyke.escape: After sidestepping the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow is your chance to respond. If Pyke R Death From Below is also down and hasn't come off cooldown, pressure him with your ally. Lulu has no ability to escape on her own, so don't overextend while Pyke still has a mobility option available.
Pyke.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Pyke E Phantom Undertow and Pyke R Death From Below target. Use Lulu W Whimsy on Pyke just before his follow-up ability, and time Lulu E Help, Pix! and Lulu R Wild Growth to protect the caught ally. Don't stand beside a low-health ally and get caught in Pyke R Death From Below's area with them.
Pyke.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps. Pyke deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Also build health, since Pyke stacks armor penetration and uses Pyke R Death From Below to target low-health enemies.
Pyke.combo: If an ally is caught, use Lulu W Whimsy to interrupt Pyke as Pyke E Phantom Undertow's dash ends and he tries to use a follow-up ability. Then shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the damage comes in and slow Pyke with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When an ally is about to die, use Lulu R Wild Growth to increase their health and knock up nearby Pyke.
Pyke.fight: React to Pyke's engage instead of forcing one yourself. If you sidestep Pyke E Phantom Undertow, he stays where he engaged, giving you a chance to slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance and respond with your ally. If only Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down, check whether Pyke R Death From Below is still available.
Pyke.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance while managing your distance and mana. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield for when Pyke engages instead of using it to poke. Keep vision when Pyke backs off to heal, so you can prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance is strong for poking, but Lulu is fragile, so avoid Pyke's engage and maintain your range advantage. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed carry and move with fragile allies who could be targeted by Pyke's execute.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you in, Pyke E Phantom Undertow can follow up with a stun, so keep your distance first. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move to the side of its dash path. If you see a shark shadow beneath your feet, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is nearby, so retreat toward an ally or your turret.

Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses is your chance to close the gap. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, but Senna E Curse of the Black Mist can increase her movement speed. When an ally gets close, help them stick to Senna with the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance and the knock-up from Lulu R Wild Growth.
Senna.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so poke her when she comes forward to collect a soul, but don't overextend since Lulu can also be taken down easily if hit. In the late game, Senna's range and attack damage grow as she collects souls, and Lulu becomes more effective as she protects her fed allies, so focus on protecting your carry.
Senna.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Senna attacks. Time Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth accordingly. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat to a place with vision or use Lulu R Wild Growth to stop enemies from approaching your ally. If Senna W Last Embrace marks you, move away so other allies aren't rooted along with you.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions in a straight line, so avoid the line between Senna and her target. Block Senna W Last Embrace with minions, and if it hits you, move away from your allies before the root triggers. After Senna hits you once, back off so she can't land a second attack and collect Mist.
Senna.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps. Senna's main damage is physical, so build armor first, and build armor alongside health instead of stacking only health.
Senna.combo: If an ally is caught, use Lulu W Whimsy on Senna first to interrupt her follow-up attack, block the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow her with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When an ally is in danger, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up Senna too if she's beside them.
Senna.fight: Poke Senna with Lulu Q Glitterlance when she steps forward to collect a soul. Instead of engaging deeply yourself, dodge Senna's attacks, protect your ally, and retaliate. If an ally closes the gap on Senna, you can use Lulu R Wild Growth on that ally to knock up Senna nearby.
Senna.laning: Track Senna's soul locations in advance and poke when she steps forward to collect them, disrupting her collection. Get out of the line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness and stand behind minions to prepare for Senna W Last Embrace. Don't waste Lulu E Help, Pix! on meaningless poke; use it as a shield when Senna's damage comes in.

Sona.phase: Sona is weakest early, before she has built up Sona P Power Chord stacks, so pressure her then. Later, Lulu becomes better at protecting a allied carry who has scaled too, so play around that ally.
Sona.teamfight: Stand apart from your allies to either side so Sona R Crescendo can’t stun multiple targets. Stay with your most fed ally and focus Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth on them. If Sona is away from her allies, her aura won’t reach them; if she gets close, cast Lulu R Wild Growth to knock her up and disrupt her position. Sona’s healing gets stronger in extended fights, so make sure your team has at least one Grievous Wounds item.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple targets in a line, so don’t line up with your allies. Watch for the cast when Sona steps forward, and create distance early when she approaches to land an empowered Sona P Power Chord attack.
Sona.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury’s Treads. Sona’s main damage is magic, and Lulu has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Sona.combo: When Sona steps forward to chain her abilities, silence her with Lulu W Whimsy. Apply a shield with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the damage comes in, then slow her with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Once you’ve closed the gap, cast Lulu R Wild Growth on an ally to knock up nearby Sona and stop her from escaping on the movement speed from Sona E Song of Celerity alone.
Sona.escape: Once Sona R Crescendo is down, you have a chance to close the gap without worrying about its stun. Decide whether to engage before Sona uses Sona E Song of Celerity for movement speed, and if you get on top of her, hold her there with the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to apply her aura, slow her with Lulu Q Glitterlance and look to trade. Lulu is fragile, so don’t force an engage; keep trading in a way that makes Sona spend mana on healing.
Sona.laning: Take advantage of Sona’s weak early game, but attack when she steps beside the minions so they don’t take Pix’s bolts for her. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! for a shield, and don’t waste mana by repeatedly casting Lulu Q Glitterlance without purpose.

Swain.fight: Poke Swain from a distance with Lulu Q Glitterlance while avoiding the out-and-back path of Swain E Nevermove. Right after Swain E Nevermove is down, you have a chance to pressure Swain with your ally since he has no escape ability. Don’t force your way in; respond to Swain’s engage with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!.
Swain.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Swain engages, then protect them with Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth. Don’t keep fighting near Swain during Swain R Demonic Ascension; move out of range, then re-engage after it ends. If Swain keeps healing in late-game fights, apply Grievous Wounds before fighting.
Swain.escape: Right after Swain E Nevermove is down, you have a chance to engage. Swain can’t create distance on his own, so close the gap with your ally and use Lulu R Wild Growth to stop him from escaping once you’ve caught him.
Swain.build: Swain’s main damage is magic, and Lulu has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with a Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury’s Treads. If Swain P Ravenous Flock and Swain R Demonic Ascension healing becomes a problem in extended fights, prepare Grievous Wounds after building resistance.
Swain.combo: If an ally is caught by Swain E Nevermove and pulled in, cast Lulu W Whimsy on Swain as he tries to follow up, shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow Swain with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix! cannot remove a root that has already landed. If your ally is about to die, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Swain.
Swain.laning: Keep your distance near maximum range so you don’t get hit by multiple bolts from Swain Q Death’s Hand. Take control early with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but leave yourself room to dodge Swain E Nevermove. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! for a shield, and don’t repeatedly spend mana on poke.
Swain.phase: Swain is vulnerable early, before Swain P Ravenous Flock stacks build up, so you have a chance to keep him suppressed. Lulu is also easily taken down if hit, so keep your distance and maintain your poke advantage. Swain becomes harder to deal with over time because of his permanent health stacks, so turn your early pressure into reduced scaling.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and then returns, so stay out of its path until it fully disappears, even after you dodge the first wave. Swain Q Death’s Hand hits more bolts at close range, so keep your distance. When Swain activates Swain R Demonic Ascension, move out of range and wait for it to end.

Velkoz.teamfight: Stay near your ally who has scaled the most and focus Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth on them when the enemy engages. If Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt it with the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth if you can reach him; if you can’t, move behind a wall to break line of sight.
Velkoz.escape: After Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses, you have a chance to close the gap. Vel’Koz has no mobility ability, but he can knock away enemies who get close with Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption, so check that it’s down and move with your ally’s engage.
Velkoz.fight: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t force your way in; look for a chance for your ally to close the gap after Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses. Vel’Koz has no mobility ability, so help your ally engage then with the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth.
Velkoz.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury’s Treads. Build magic resistance to withstand Vel’Koz’s main magic damage, but Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray deal true damage that resistance can’t block, so prioritize avoiding consecutive hits from his abilities.
Velkoz.combo: If an ally is caught, interrupt the follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy, shield against the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow Vel’Koz with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When an ally is about to die to burst, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies. If Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray has started and you can reach him, prioritize interrupting the ray with the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth.
Velkoz.laning: Pressure Vel’Koz with the poke and slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t walk forward into his attacks as fragile Lulu. Watch Vel’Koz’s cast animations and use Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield instead of using it for repeated poke, and look for a time to recall if you run out of mana.
Velkoz.phase: Lulu Q Glitterlance offers strong early poke, but Lulu is fragile, so trade while dodging Vel’Koz’s ability combos. Later, prioritize protecting your fed ally carry.
Velkoz.watch: Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission can split, so dodge the diverging bolt too; don’t only move sideways—move toward Vel’Koz or to the space behind the bolt after it passes. If Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption knocks you up and he chains abilities on you, Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction deals true damage. If stacks are applied, back off and let them expire.

Zyra.teamfight: Don't fight in areas where Zyra has been set up for a long time or where her plants have gathered; move elsewhere and fight there. Stay beside your ally who has scaled the most, watch for Zyra's engage and Zyra E Grasping Roots, and protect them with Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, move outside its area.
Zyra.escape: After dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots, look for a chance to close the distance. Zyra has no way to escape on her own, but Lulu also has no escape ability, so don't force an engage; counterattack with your allies when Zyra goes in.
Zyra.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If the enemy has a lot of crowd control that keeps allies in place, get Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Zyra.combo: If an ally is caught by Zyra E Grasping Roots, use Lulu W Whimsy on Zyra first to interrupt her follow-up ability, then protect your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! in time with the incoming damage. Follow up with Lulu Q Glitterlance to slow her, and if your ally is about to die, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up Zyra if she is close.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways, then poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance's slow while that ability is down. If Zyra overcommits, use Lulu W Whimsy to interrupt her follow-up ability and trade back. Back off from areas covered in plants and fight after they disappear.
Zyra.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don't stand in Zyra E Grasping Roots's linear path for long. If Zyra uses an ability to grow her seeds, don't walk in to step on them; back off, then clear the seeds later. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! for its shield, and if you're low on mana, don't force a play; set up a good time to recall.
Zyra.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance provides strong poke, but Lulu can be taken down easily if Zyra E Grasping Roots hits her. Later, Lulu becomes much stronger at protecting a fed allied carry, so prioritize helping that ally grow.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots's linear root catches you, plant damage and the knock-up from Zyra R Stranglethorns can follow, so dodge sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, walk out of its area, and don't fight where her plants have gathered.

Leona.fight: When Leona W Eclipse is active, don’t stay close and trade damage; move out of its area. Poke with your range and Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t force physical damage trades against Leona’s high early-game defenses. Close the distance and counterattack right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down.
Leona.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Leona E Zenith Blade targets. Respond with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!. If the Leona P Sunlight mark appears, it signals that the enemy’s follow-up damage is coming, so don’t step forward; back away. If your ally is in danger, use Lulu R Wild Growth to increase their health and knock up Leona nearby.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and attaches Leona to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a straight line with your allied marksman. Leona can approach with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak already activated, so watch the distance and dodge rather than waiting to see whether she uses it. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the center stun. When Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its area before it explodes.
Leona.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Leona deals mostly magic damage, so magic resistance is a priority for Lulu. If the enemy team has a lot of persistent crowd control that can hold your allies in place, get Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Leona.combo: If an ally is hit by Leona E Zenith Blade, cast Lulu W Whimsy on Leona as she tries to use follow-up abilities after her dash ends. Then shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! and slow Leona with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally takes heavy damage and is in danger, use Lulu R Wild Growth to increase their health and knock up Leona nearby.
Leona.escape: Leona E Zenith Blade is her mobility tool, so the moment after you bait it out is your window to engage. Confirm that Leona’s engage ability is down before counterattacking. If you use Lulu R Wild Growth on an ally who has engaged, it knocks Leona up and makes it harder for her to escape.
Leona.laning: Lulu should keep her distance and counter Leona’s engage instead of going in deep first. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield for the moment Leona engages and tries to deal damage, rather than using it to poke. Don’t waste mana by repeatedly using Lulu Q Glitterlance and Lulu E Help, Pix! for meaningless poke.
Leona.phase: Early on, Lulu can poke with her range and Lulu Q Glitterlance, but distance management comes first because you can easily take successive hits once Leona catches you. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry.

Morgana.combo: If an ally is caught, interrupt the enemy’s follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy, shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the incoming damage arrives, then slow the enemy with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When your ally takes heavy damage, use Lulu R Wild Growth to immediately increase their maximum health and knock up nearby enemies. If Morgana E Black Shield is active, check the target so you don’t waste your crowd control.
Morgana.build: Early on, use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Morgana’s magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Get Mikael's Blessing earlier if your allies keep getting caught by Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana R Soul Shackles. Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix! cannot remove crowd control that has already landed.
Morgana.escape: The window to engage with your ally is after Morgana Q Dark Binding is down and while Morgana E Black Shield is unavailable. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so after closing in, you can use Lulu R Wild Growth on an ally to knock up Morgana nearby. Lulu has no ability to escape on her own, so don’t close the distance alone first.
Morgana.fight: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but first keep a safe distance and angle to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. Don’t use Lulu’s crowd control on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. After Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield are down, help your ally engage with the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance.
Morgana.laning: Move along the minion wave so the minions can block Morgana Q Dark Binding. Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield timed against Morgana’s attacks. Don’t spend mana on meaningless poke, and when you’re out of mana, look for a chance to recall instead of forcing a play.
Morgana.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance has strong poke and slow, but Lulu herself can easily fall apart if hit, so prioritize dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding. In the late game, Lulu gets stronger the more she focuses on protecting her fed allied carry.
Morgana.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Morgana Q Dark Binding or Morgana R Soul Shackles targets. When an enemy engages and tries to use follow-up abilities, cast Lulu W Whimsy, then shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the damage comes in. If your ally is about to take heavy damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.
Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding catches only the first target it hits, so avoid it by keeping minions between you and Morgana. If you’re hit, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will come next. The pool is more dangerous when you’re low on health, so don’t step into it even while retreating. Morgana R Soul Shackles stuns after a delay, so move out of range when the tether appears.

Xerath.escape: Engage right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Xerath has no mobility ability, so after closing the gap, cast Lulu R Wild Growth on an ally to knock up nearby Xerath and help your engage.
Xerath.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand his damage, then buy Mercury’s Treads. Xerath’s main damage is magic, and Lulu has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Xerath.combo: If an ally is caught, interrupt the enemy’s follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy, shield against the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow them with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Just before an ally is taken down by burst, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth; if Xerath is nearby, knock him up too.
Xerath.fight: Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, you have a chance to close the gap. Slow Xerath with Lulu Q Glitterlance, then use Lulu W Whimsy on him as he tries to cast a follow-up ability and trade with your ally.
Xerath.laning: Use Lulu Q Glitterlance to poke early, but don’t force an angle because Lulu is fragile. Farm while dodging Xerath’s heavy damage, and use Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield when you see his cast animation. After Xerath spends a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Early on, watch out for Xerath’s long range and avoid forced trades as fragile Lulu. In the mid game, use Lulu R Wild Growth to save allies and punish Xerath when he overreaches. In the late game, stay beside your fed allied carry and prioritize protecting them.
Xerath.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch Xerath’s attacks so you can block the damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!. Grant that ally movement and attack speed with Lulu W Whimsy, and save them with Lulu R Wild Growth just before they go down.
Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you can take a chain of follow-up magic damage, so prioritize dodging that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and move sideways. Start dodging immediately when you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Bard.fight: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don't force a fight first. Close the distance right after Bard E Magical Journey is down, and if you can get close, use Lulu R Wild Growth to knock him up and prevent his escape. If an ally is caught, interrupt Bard's follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy and absorb the damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so avoid standing with your back to a wall or lining up with an ally or minion. Bard E Magical Journey can bring him in from the side, so watch your flank and interrupt him with Lulu W Whimsy just after his engage ends, as he tries to use a follow-up ability. Watch the area of Bard R Tempered Fate, which makes targets inside it immune to damage.
Bard.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard P Traveler's Call and Bard Q Cosmic Binding deal magic damage, so build magic resistance. Tenacity is also important because getting focused after Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns you is dangerous.
Bard.combo: If Bard uses Bard E Magical Journey to engage on an ally, interrupt his follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy right after his engage ends. Time Lulu E Help, Pix! with the incoming damage, then slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to die to burst damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies who engaged.
Bard.escape: Bard E Magical Journey is his only escape, so right after he uses it is your window to approach or catch him out. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down too, move in while staying positioned to dodge the stun. Check that it's safe before chasing through the portal.
Bard.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance early on, but save enough mana to use Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield. If you see Bard W Caretaker's Shrine in the lane, walk over it to remove it.
Bard.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance gives you strong poke, but Lulu is fragile, so focus on turning back Bard's engages. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry.
Bard.teamfight: Stay by your most fed ally and watch who Bard E Magical Journey is targeting. If that ally is caught, interrupt Bard's follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy and absorb the damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!. If your ally is about to die, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.

Alistar.teamfight: Stay by your most fed ally and watch who Alistar W Headbutt targets. Protect them with Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't spend your damage on him; back off. If you can't retreat, wait until Alistar casts his ultimate, then use Lulu R Wild Growth to knock him up again and stop his engage.
Alistar.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Alistar deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Alistar.combo: Just after Alistar W Headbutt ends, as he tries to use a follow-up ability, cast Lulu W Whimsy on Alistar when he engages on an ally. Time Lulu E Help, Pix! on your ally to absorb the incoming damage, then slow Alistar with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to die, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Alistar.
Alistar.escape: Right after you bait out Alistar W Headbutt is your window while his mobility spell is down. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, close the distance to counterattack or move to a favorable position.
Alistar.laning: Keep your distance and poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! to blunt Alistar's engage damage. Don't waste mana by repeatedly using Lulu Q Glitterlance and Lulu E Help, Pix! for meaningless poke. Even when defending near your turret, don't leave room for Alistar to circle behind you.
Alistar.phase: Early on, Lulu has strong poke and slows but is easily taken down if hit, so managing your distance comes first. In the late game, Lulu gets stronger by protecting her allied carry's growth, so fight by that carry's side.
Alistar.watch: If Alistar W Headbutt engages on you, it can lead into Alistar Q Pulverize's knockup and Alistar E Trample's stun, so keep your distance. Near a turret, don't give Alistar room to circle behind you and knock you toward the turret.
Alistar.fight: Trade after responding to Alistar’s engage rather than forcing an opening yourself. Once Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down, reposition or counterattack. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off and fight again after it wears off.

Hwei.escape: Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is your chance to close the distance. Hwei has no mobility ability, so if an ally manages to get close, help their engage with Lulu R Wild Growth.
Hwei.fight: Don't force an engage while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available. If he uses it for poke or wave clear, and an ally closes the distance right after, help the engaging ally with Lulu R Wild Growth. During a trade, watch Hwei's cast animation and time Lulu E Help, Pix!'s shield accordingly.
Hwei.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage and Lulu has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: If an ally is caught by Hwei, first cast Lulu W Whimsy on the enemy to interrupt Hwei's follow-up abilities. Time Lulu E Help, Pix!'s shield with the incoming damage, then slow Hwei with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to be hit by burst damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.
Hwei.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don't force an opening because you're fragile. If Hwei tries to hit you with abilities in succession, immediately move away from where the first one hit. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! for its shield, and if you're low on mana, don't force a fight; set up a recall.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance has strong poke and slows, but Lulu is fragile, so you need to avoid Hwei's combo damage. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry.
Hwei.teamfight: Stay close to your most fed ally and watch who Hwei E Subject: Torment targets. If an ally is caught, interrupt Hwei's follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy and block the damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!. Use Lulu R Wild Growth just before the burst damage lands, and take a detour around corridors where Hwei has placed ground effects.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks enemies up at the landing point after his dash, so sidestep when he starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, interrupt his follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy before he can reach you, or put terrain between you. Don't stand in a line with multiple allies.
Rakan.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads. Rakan deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. After that, prioritize a way to remove crowd control instead of stacking more resistance.
Rakan.combo: When Rakan engages on an ally, cast Lulu W Whimsy on him right after he lands to interrupt his follow-up. Then cast Lulu E Help, Pix! on your ally as the damage comes in, and slow Rakan with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Just before an ally takes burst damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Rakan.
Rakan.escape: Right after Rakan W Grand Entrance misses or is down is your chance to close the gap. Rakan E Battle Dance can only target allied champions, so look for an opportunity to catch him when he's alone and away from his allies. Lulu R Wild Growth can knock him up to stop his escape.
Rakan.fight: Look to trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is removed. Keep your distance and poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance instead of forcing an engage yourself. If Rakan commits heavily to an engage, respond with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!.
Rakan.laning: Watch Rakan W Grand Entrance's landing point and keep enough distance to sidestep. Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance while conserving mana, and use Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield when damage comes in. Minions can take Pix's bolts instead, so poke with basic attacks when Rakan steps out beside the minion wave.
Rakan.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance is strong for poking, but Lulu can be taken down easily if she gets hit, so prioritize keeping your distance. From the mid game onward, continue protecting your allied carry's growth, and fight alongside your fed carry in the late game.
Rakan.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance target. Right after Rakan lands, interrupt his follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy and cast Lulu E Help, Pix! to match the incoming damage. When Rakan gets onto an ally, use Lulu R Wild Growth to save them and knock up nearby Rakan.

Thresh.phase: Lulu Q Glitterlance offers strong early poke and a slow, but Lulu herself is fragile, so your priority is to avoid getting caught by Thresh. Later, focus on protecting your fed ally carry.
Thresh.watch: If Thresh Q Death Sentence hits, the follow-up engage is dangerous, so sidestep when you see him winding up his hook. Be especially careful to change direction when moving up for a last hit, and avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay can’t pull you toward them.
Thresh.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury’s Treads. Build magic resistance against Thresh’s damage, but tenacity is also important because the damage after Lulu gets caught is dangerous.
Thresh.combo: If an ally is caught, use Lulu W Whimsy to interrupt Thresh as his dash ends and he tries to cast a follow-up ability. Shield against the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When an ally is about to be killed by burst damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies who engage.
Thresh.escape: Right after you dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence, you have a chance to close the gap. If Thresh W Dark Passage has also been used and its cooldown has not yet ended, look to engage with Lulu R Wild Growth to prevent Thresh from escaping.
Thresh.fight: Poke Thresh with Lulu Q Glitterlance when he walks forward to collect a soul. After dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, close the gap, but check whether Thresh W Dark Passage is down before you fight.
Thresh.laning: Don’t force an angle; keep your distance and respond to Thresh’s engage. The minions can take Pix’s bolts for the enemy, so poke when the enemy steps beside the minions. Keep Lulu E Help, Pix! available for shielding, along with enough mana to cast it.
Thresh.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and protect them from engages with Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh W Dark Passage using Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth. If you’re trapped in Thresh R The Box, have your toughest ally choose a wall to break so the rest can escape. If Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown out, decide whether to finish off the target immediately or fall back.

Zilean.escape: After dodging two Zilean Q Time Bombs, look for a chance to close the distance. Zilean has no mobility ability, so if you manage to get close, you can use Lulu R Wild Growth to knock up nearby Zilean and prevent him from escaping. If Lulu engages alone, Zilean E Time Warp can catch her, so go in with allies.
Zilean.teamfight: Stay beside your most fed ally, watch for the enemy engage, and protect them with Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth. If an ally has a Zilean Q Time Bomb attached, move away so you don't get stunned with them. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on the enemy carry and makes them hard to finish, switch your target to Zilean himself.
Zilean.watch: When two Zilean Q Time Bombs attach, they stun, so move away from allies as soon as the first bomb attaches and get outside the blast radius. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on a target, don't use abilities on them while they are reviving; wait until its duration ends or target them just after they revive.
Zilean.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Zilean's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Tenacity is the priority because getting caught by Zilean's bomb stun and Zilean E Time Warp slow is dangerous; build magic resistance.
Zilean.combo: When Zilean targets an ally, cast Lulu W Whimsy on the enemy just after the engage ends, as the enemy is about to use a follow-up ability. Cast Lulu E Help, Pix! on your ally in time with the incoming damage, then slow with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to go down to burst damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.
Zilean.fight: If an ally is caught, use Lulu W Whimsy to interrupt the follow-up ability and Lulu E Help, Pix! to block incoming damage.
Zilean.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but save Lulu E Help, Pix! for its shield. If you run out of mana, don't force a play; set up a good time to recall.

Maokai.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t repeatedly hit Maokai with abilities and let Maokai P Sap Magic heal too often. Use your poke abilities on the enemy damage dealers and save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield. When Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, stay out of range near bushes, and set up a recall when you’re out of mana.
Maokai.build: Early on, build magic resistance first with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. After that, choose your resistances based on the enemy damage dealers dealing damage while Maokai holds a target in place. Get Mikael's Blessing earlier if the enemy team has a lot of persistent crowd control that can hold your allies in place.
Maokai.combo: If Maokai W Twisted Advance catches an ally, interrupt Maokai’s follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy right after he lands. Shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the incoming damage arrives, then slow Maokai with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to die, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up Maokai nearby.
Maokai.escape: Right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, Maokai has a harder time reengaging, so you can close the distance. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp is also down, look for a chance to use Lulu R Wild Growth on an ally who has engaged and knock Maokai up.
Maokai.fight: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, keep your distance and don’t force an engage. If Maokai dashes in, interrupt his follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy right after he lands and block the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!. The moment after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down is your chance to step forward and trade damage.
Maokai.phase: Early on, Lulu’s poke and slow with Lulu Q Glitterlance are strong, but distance management comes first because she is fragile. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Maokai W Twisted Advance targets. Protect them with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!. In a dangerous moment, use Lulu R Wild Growth on that ally to save them and knock up Maokai nearby. Fight in open terrain where there’s room to dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp sideways.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance makes Maokai untargetable during the dash and roots Lulu when he lands. Don’t waste Lulu W Whimsy during the dash; interrupt Maokai’s follow-up abilities right after he lands. Don’t enter bushes with Maokai E Sapling Toss in them. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, dodge perpendicular to its path, and don’t fight in narrow corridors.

Neeko.teamfight: Stay spread out near your fed allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can’t root several of you at once. If disguised Neeko approaches, spread out in advance. After she engages with Neeko R Pop Blossom, stop her follow-up attacks with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth. Cast Lulu E Help, Pix! on an ally as the damage comes in to shield them.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so don’t stand on top of an ally. If Neeko approaches while disguised, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may not be visible, so spread out as soon as a suspicious opponent gets close. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch the real Neeko’s position.
Neeko.build: Early on, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Neeko’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If being caught by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs leads into Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.combo: If an ally is caught, interrupt Neeko’s follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy right after she finishes engaging. Shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the incoming damage arrives, then slow Neeko with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Just before your ally takes heavy damage, use Lulu R Wild Growth to increase their health and knock up Neeko nearby.
Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your chance to trade damage. However, Lulu has no ability to escape on her own, so respond from a safe distance instead of going in deep first.
Neeko.fight: Keep your distance and counterattack when Neeko engages instead of forcing an engage first. When Neeko tries to use follow-up abilities after closing in with Neeko R Pop Blossom, interrupt her with Lulu W Whimsy and block the incoming damage to your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix!.
Neeko.laning: Early on, poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t give Neeko E Tangle-Barbs an angle because Lulu is fragile and has no ability to escape. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield rather than using it to poke, and don’t spend mana on meaningless poke. If a minion is between you, it can absorb Pix’s bolt, so poke Neeko with basic attacks when she steps beside the minion wave.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry.

Rell.fight: Lulu has no ability to escape, so don't try to close in first. Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. Rell has low magic resistance early and no way to heal, so chip her down with Lulu's magic damage from a safe distance. After Rell engages, interrupt her follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy, protect your ally, and retaliate.
Rell.teamfight: Before a team fight, space out from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can't pull several of you in together. Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down or Rell E Full Tilt targets. Interrupt her follow-up right after she dashes with Lulu W Whimsy. After Rell Q Shattering Strike, block the damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, and use Lulu R Wild Growth just before an ally takes heavy damage.
Rell.watch: If Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and one ally together, that's a signal she's about to engage, so stop trading and move out of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so sidestep its line and use Lulu E Help, Pix! after Rell Q Shattering Strike passes. Before a team fight, space out from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can't pull several of you in together.
Rell.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads. Rell deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Rell P Break the Mold reduces resistances, and Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health, so don't rely on stacking only health.
Rell.combo: If an ally is caught, cast Lulu W Whimsy on Rell as her dash ends and she tries to use a follow-up ability. After Rell Q Shattering Strike passes, shield your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the damage comes in, then slow Rell with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Just before an ally takes heavy damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Rell.
Rell.escape: Wait until both Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and Rell E Full Tilt are down before engaging. If only one is down, she can escape with the other mobility option, so especially look for the window before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up. Then knock Rell up with Lulu R Wild Growth to make it hard for her to escape.
Rell.laning: If Rell approaches mounted or charges in with Rell E Full Tilt, move out of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. Immediately after Rell uses Crash Down, create distance so Rell is left alone, then poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance when it is safe. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield, and look for a good time to recall when you run low on mana.
Rell.phase: Early on, Lulu's Q poke is strong and Rell has low magic resistance, but Lulu can be taken down easily if caught by Rell's engage. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed carry.

Soraka.escape: When Soraka E Equinox is down, you have a chance to engage. Soraka has no dash, so if your ally closes the gap, help hold her there with the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Soraka.laning: Help your ADC pressure the enemy so Soraka has to use Soraka W Astral Infusion, which lowers Soraka’s health. To keep up that pressure, dodge Soraka Q Starcall. Don’t waste Lulu E Help, Pix! on meaningless poke; save it to block incoming damage.
Soraka.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Soraka’s magic damage, then buy Mercury’s Treads. If extended fights make Soraka’s healing a problem, consider Grievous Wounds after building magic resistance.
Soraka.combo: If an ally is caught, interrupt the enemy’s follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy, shield the ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the damage comes in, then slow the enemy with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is at serious risk of dying, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Soraka.
Soraka.fight: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance and take short trades while dodging Soraka Q Starcall. Once Soraka E Equinox is down, close the gap with your ally’s engage. If Soraka is near an ally, you can knock her up with Lulu R Wild Growth.
Soraka.phase: Early Lulu Q Glitterlance poke is strong, but Lulu is fragile, and Soraka can withstand long trades with her healing. Later, focus on protecting your fed ally carry.
Soraka.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and respond to enemy engages with Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth. If Soraka is exposed nearby, help your allies target her directly. Keep in mind Soraka R Wish heals all allies, so focus your damage in a short window.
Soraka.watch: Dodge Soraka Q Starcall, since being hit by it heals Soraka and grants her movement speed. Soraka E Equinox silences you within its zone and can then root you, so move away or finish your engage before stepping into the zone.

Janna.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but don’t step forward to look for an angle first because you’re fragile. Pressure Janna to use Janna E Eye Of The Storm on an ally, and bait out Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr to take control. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield, and set up a recall when you’re low on mana.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale makes a sound as it charges, so move out of its path if you hear it from a bush or outside your vision. The target of Janna E Eye Of The Storm gets a shield and increased attack damage, so don’t commit your damage during that window. Janna R Monsoon knocks enemies in a fight away and heals nearby allies.
Janna.build: Early on, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Janna deals mostly magic damage, and Lulu has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Janna.combo: If an ally is caught, cast Lulu W Whimsy on the enemy as they try to use follow-up abilities right after engaging. Then time Lulu E Help, Pix! to shield your ally against the incoming damage and slow the enemy with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to die, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies who have moved in.
Janna.escape: The window to close the distance is after Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr are down. Check whether Janna R Monsoon is still available, since it can knock you back when you engage. Look for an opportunity when Janna is caught alone.
Janna.fight: Poke the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then commit your damage. Bait Janna into wasting Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr, then look for a chance to close the distance. If Lulu engages too aggressively first, she won’t have enough damage to finish the fight, so play around the enemy’s movements.
Janna.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance is strong for poking, but Lulu herself is fragile and an opponent shielded by Janna E Eye Of The Storm can hit back hard, so trade carefully. After Lulu learns Lulu R Wild Growth in the mid game, she becomes much better at countering engages on her allies. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry.
Janna.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who the enemy engage targets. Use Lulu W Whimsy, Lulu E Help, Pix!, and Lulu R Wild Growth to respond. If Janna is positioned behind an allied damage dealer, the engage may be pushed back, so establish vision and look for a moment when Janna is caught alone.

Nami.fight: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to go after her. Nami has low health and no mobility ability, but Lulu has no ability to escape on her own either, so don't force an early approach. If an ally is caught, interrupt the follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy and block the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns you if it hits, so sidestep when you see its tell. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave as soon as you see it, too; if it hits, Nami can follow up with Nami Q Aqua Prison. Don't fight head-on against an enemy empowered by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; wait for its duration to end.
Nami.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Nami's main damage is magic, and Lulu has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Nami.combo: If an ally is caught by Nami's crowd control and the enemy follows up, interrupt their follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy. Cast Lulu E Help, Pix! as the damage comes in, then slow them with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When an ally is about to go down from heavy damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.
Nami.escape: Close the gap right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. If you've also dodged Nami R Tidal Wave and Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing has expired, Nami is a good target. She has no mobility ability, so once you close the gap, it's hard for her to get away.
Nami.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance while keeping enough distance to dodge Nami Q Aqua Prison. Account for the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow: don't waste mana on meaningless poke, and save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield. Use basic attacks to poke when Nami steps out beside the minion wave, so minions don't take Pix's bolts instead.
Nami.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance is strong for poking and slowing, but Lulu herself is fragile, so prioritize keeping your distance. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed carry.
Nami.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave target. When an enemy engages and tries to follow up, interrupt them with Lulu W Whimsy and cast Lulu E Help, Pix! to match the incoming damage. When an ally is about to go down, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.

Seraphine.teamfight: Stand apart from your allies to either side so Seraphine R Encore can’t chain through multiple targets. Stay near your most fed ally and watch for the enemy engage, then use Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!. When that ally is about to take heavy damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you’re slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine first. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits one of your allied champions, so don’t line up with your allies.
Seraphine.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury’s Treads. Seraphine’s main damage is magic, and Lulu has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Seraphine.combo: If an ally is caught, interrupt the follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy, block the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow Seraphine with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you can close the gap, cast Lulu R Wild Growth on an ally to knock up Seraphine if she’s nearby.
Seraphine.escape: Engage right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Seraphine has no ability to create distance on her own, so you can pressure her by closing the gap then. If you’re slowed, prioritize moving out of the line of Seraphine E Beat Drop over engaging.
Seraphine.fight: Look to trade when Seraphine is standing alone, away from her ADC. Right after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the gap. Don’t force an engage; trade back against Seraphine’s attacks with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!.
Seraphine.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance, but keep your distance because Lulu is fragile. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! for a shield against Seraphine’s attacks instead of using it for repeated poke. If you run out of mana, don’t force things; look for a good time to recall.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance deals strong poke and slows, but Lulu is easily taken down if hit, so keep your distance. Later, focus on protecting your fed ally carry.

Braum.teamfight: Stay close to your most fed ally and watch who Braum W Stand Behind Me targets. Protect your most fed ally with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!. Position yourself to avoid Braum R Glacial Fissure's line and slow zone, and use Lulu R Wild Growth as soon as an ally is in danger. Look for an angle to attack Braum from the side or after Braum E Unbreakable's shield drops, rather than only from the front.
Braum.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Braum's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Tenacity is also important because Lulu has no escape ability and is vulnerable to Braum's stuns and knockups.
Braum.combo: Just after Braum W Stand Behind Me ends, as he tries to use a follow-up ability, interrupt him with Lulu W Whimsy. When the damage comes in, cast Lulu E Help, Pix! on your ally and slow Braum with Lulu Q Glitterlance to create distance. If your ally is about to take heavy damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Braum.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum uses Braum W Stand Behind Me is your window while his mobility spell is down. You can close the distance with an ally and target an opponent, but if you're marked by Braum P Concussive Blows, get out of range before the stacks fill.
Braum.fight: Don't dive in and start a fight; wait for Braum to engage with Braum W Stand Behind Me, then counterattack. If Braum E Unbreakable is blocking the front, don't rush Lulu Q Glitterlance; wait for the shield to drop or find an angle to hit him from the side.
Braum.laning: Braum Q Winter's Bite hits only the first enemy it contacts, so stand behind minions and don't face Braum in a straight line when there are gaps between them. Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance while conserving mana, and save Lulu E Help, Pix! to shield against the moment Braum deals damage.
Braum.phase: Early on, Lulu is easily taken down if hit, so keep your distance and look to win trades using only Lulu Q Glitterlance. In the late game, focus on protecting your fed allied carry.
Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter's Bite or a basic attack marks you with Braum P Concussive Blows, get out of range before the stun triggers. When you see Braum R Glacial Fissure's cast animation, dodge sideways out of its line and stay out of the slow zone it leaves behind.

Pantheon.phase: Pantheon is strong early, so avoid trading blows and focus on not giving him a kill. His influence falls off as the game goes on, while Lulu gets stronger the more she can protect her fed carry.
Pantheon.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps. Pantheon's main damage is physical, and Lulu has low armor, so build armor first.
Pantheon.combo: If Pantheon uses Pantheon W Shield Vault to get onto an ally, cast Lulu W Whimsy on him as his dash ends and he tries to use a follow-up ability. Then protect your ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! as the damage comes in and slow Pantheon with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to die, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby Pantheon.
Pantheon.escape: Don't engage just because Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. Wait until Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also down and he can't use both mobility options in succession. During that window, use Lulu R Wild Growth to knock up Pantheon after he engages.
Pantheon.fight: Don't engage Pantheon to trade blows; poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance and wait for him to engage. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don't attack him from the front. Wait for it to end or angle in from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear when he uses it to poke. For Lulu's basic attacks, wait until Pantheon steps out beside the minion wave so minions don't take Pix's bolts instead. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield, and look for a good time to recall when you run low on mana.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch who Pantheon W Shield Vault and Pantheon R Grand Starfall target. When Pantheon engages, cast Lulu W Whimsy just as he tries to use a follow-up ability, and protect the caught ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns an enemy, so don't give him the range to use it. When Pantheon Q Comet Spear is used as a long-range poke, keep minions between you and him. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Blitzcrank.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Blitzcrank's main damage abilities, Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field, deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Blitzcrank.combo: If an ally is caught by Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, cast Lulu W Whimsy on Blitzcrank just after he engages, as he tries to use a follow-up ability, to silence him. Time Lulu E Help, Pix!'s shield with the incoming damage, then slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance. If your ally is about to die, use Lulu R Wild Growth to increase their max health and knock up enemies nearby.
Blitzcrank.escape: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to step forward and trade. Treat it as a safe window when Blitzcrank is out of mana and can't use his hook, but keep your distance because Lulu has no ability to escape on her own.
Blitzcrank.fight: Push the lane or trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses. Keep your distance and poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance instead of diving in first. If Blitzcrank engages, turn on him with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!.
Blitzcrank.laning: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls only the first target it hits, so stand behind minions rather than beside them. Use a Control Ward to get vision in the brush and watch Blitzcrank's mana bar. Don't repeatedly use Lulu Q Glitterlance and Lulu E Help, Pix! for meaningless poke; if you're low on mana, set up a recall.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, Lulu Q Glitterlance gives you strong poke, but Lulu is easily taken down if caught, so prioritize playing around Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. In the mid game, save allies with Lulu R Wild Growth and turn back Blitzcrank's reckless engages. In the late game, Lulu becomes more valuable by protecting a fed allied carry, so prioritize the carry's survival over your own growth.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stay by your most fed ally and watch who Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is aimed at. If Blitzcrank catches an ally, interrupt his follow-up abilities with Lulu W Whimsy and protect that ally with Lulu E Help, Pix! and Lulu R Wild Growth. Focus on protecting your allied carry rather than spending all your abilities on Blitzcrank.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, it can lead into the knockup from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field, so keep minions in front of you and maintain your distance. When you lack vision in the brush, it's hard to see where a hook will come from, so stay well away from it. Blitzcrank R Static Field breaks shields, so don't rely on only Lulu E Help, Pix!'s shield to survive.

Renata.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Renata Glasc’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that locks down allies, prioritize Mikael’s Blessing sooner, since Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix! can’t remove crowd control that has already landed.
Renata.combo: If an ally is caught by Renata Glasc Q Handshake, cast Lulu W Whimsy on Renata first to interrupt her follow-up abilities, block the ensuing damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow her with Lulu Q Glitterlance. When an ally is about to die, use Lulu R Wild Growth to increase their maximum health and knock up nearby enemies.
Renata.escape: Look to close the gap after Renata Glasc Q Handshake misses or is down. Renata has no innate mobility, so if an ally gets on her, help keep her there with the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance and the knock-up from Lulu R Wild Growth. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is still available, engage while keeping your distance from allies.
Renata.fight: Rather than forcing a fight, punish Renata Glasc when she uses an ability. Dodge Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to the side, and if an ally closes the gap on Renata, help catch her with the knock-up from Lulu R Wild Growth. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is still available, don’t engage in a line with your team.
Renata.laning: Use Lulu Q Glitterlance to maintain your advantage in poke and slows, but don’t force an angle with your fragile body. If minions are between you, they can block the beam from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, so weave in basic attacks when Renata Glasc steps beside the minions. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! as a shield to block Renata Glasc’s damage rather than for poke, and recall if you’re low on mana.
Renata.phase: Lulu has strong early poke, but is fragile, so fight by responding to Renata Glasc’s engages. In the late game, prioritize protecting your scaled allied carry.
Renata.teamfight: Stay beside your strongest ally and watch for who gets caught by abilities such as Renata Glasc Q Handshake; respond with Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu E Help, Pix!. Use Lulu R Wild Growth just before that ally dies to save them and knock up nearby enemies. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your team spaced out so they don’t engage grouped together.
Renata.watch: Stand behind minions or your frontline because Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target it hits and can stun an ally too if Renata throws that target into them. If you’re hit by Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, you’ll attack nearby allies, so keep your distance from them while her R is available. If you kill an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, back off with nearby allies so that enemy can’t participate in a takedown and revive.

Taric.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury’s Treads. Taric’s main damage is magic, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Taric.combo: When an enemy linked by Taric engages, use Lulu W Whimsy to interrupt them as their dash ends and they try to cast a follow-up ability. Shield against the incoming damage with Lulu E Help, Pix!, then slow them with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Just before an ally takes heavy damage, save them with Lulu R Wild Growth and knock up nearby enemies.
Taric.escape: Right after sidestepping Taric E Dazzle, you have a chance to poke while keeping your distance. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you get an angle to catch him, knock him up with Lulu R Wild Growth to help your team engage.
Taric.fight: Dodge Taric E Dazzle, keep your range, and poke and slow him with Lulu Q Glitterlance. Maintaining enough distance to keep Taric from reaching a target he can auto-attack can also delay his ability rotation. If you get a chance to catch Taric, knock him up with Lulu R Wild Growth so he can’t get away.
Taric.laning: Poke with Lulu Q Glitterlance early, but avoid close trades where Taric can hit you with empowered Taric P Bravado attacks. Trade when Taric E Dazzle is down, and manage your distance so it’s hard for him to get close to the minion wave for an auto-attack. Save Lulu E Help, Pix! for a shield, and look for a time to recall if you run out of mana.
Taric.phase: Lulu Q Glitterlance offers strong early poke, but Taric P Bravado’s melee damage is also threatening, so keep your range. Later, focus on protecting your fed ally carry.
Taric.teamfight: Stay near your most fed ally and watch for engages by the champion linked with Taric W Bastion. Just after they engage, interrupt their follow-up with Lulu W Whimsy, then use Lulu E Help, Pix! and Lulu R Wild Growth in response to the damage. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants invulnerability, stop attacking and manage their position with tools like the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth; attack again when the invulnerability ends.
Taric.watch: When you see the warning for Taric E Dazzle, sidestep to dodge it. Don’t dump your damage while Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s invulnerability is active.
